Francis Halzen.
:::

::: {.column width="56%"}
**2026 Nobel Prize in Physics**

IceCube and the discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.

> [Dmitry Naumov to Francis Halzen:]{style="font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 0.6em; color: #9fb3c8;"}\
> [“Let me warmly congratulate you and the entire IceCube Collaboration on this thoroughly deserved Nobel Prize in Physics! … I am Dmitry Naumov — a Baikalist, from JINR (Dubna). We have met several times over the years, most recently at the JUNO cafeteria, where we had lunch together and I even ‘predicted’ your Nobel Prize.”]{style="font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.68em;"}

> [Francis Halzen to Dmitry Naumov:]{style="font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 0.6em; color: #9fb3c8;"}\
> [“Dmitry, I know you since the Naumov flux and remember the lunch in the JUNO cafeteria very well. Thanks for your very kind message.”]{style="font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.68em;"}

::: {.media-caption}
[IceCube, 6 October 2026](https://icecube.wisc.edu/news/awards/2026/10/francis-halzen-icecube-principal-investigator-wins-2026-physics-nobel-prize/)
:::
:::
:::::

### So what?

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 1.2em;"}
[$1\,\mathrm{PeV} = 10^{15}\,\mathrm{eV}$]{style="font-size: 2.4em;"}

[in a single neutrino]{style="font-size: 1.3em;"}

[a billion times a neutrino from the Sun]{style="font-size: 1.3em;"}

[over a hundred times a proton in the LHC]{style="font-size: 1.3em;"}

::: {.question style="margin-top: 1.2em;"}
[Not nuclear fusion. Then what? And where?]{style="font-size: 1.4em;"}
:::
